pages.text: Health 20, Attack 3, Speed 0.25.$(br)It can use bows, crossbows, swords, axes, shields and tridents normally, and eats food to heal.$(br)$(br)With a trident in its main hand it keeps throwing at targets beyond 6 blocks, and closes to melee inside 6 blocks.$(br)

$(l)Shield$(): at 6-10 blocks it keeps its guard up without sneaking closer; within 6 blocks it raises the shield while sneaking, where the guard is almost never knocked back. Both modes share one continuous block counter -- 5 blocks normally, 8 while sneaking; reaching the cap always breaks the guard.$(br)
Using an Arcane Scroll on it awakens its magical wits, after which it casts with a wand; on death it returns the scroll with its nbt, which can be used on another player mob servant to revive it.
